title: Easy Crisp Malaysian Filo Pastry Samosas
description: A yeasty and crisp Malaysian dish featuring filo pastry, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this kosher-friendly recipe is a delicious and flavorful twist on traditional samosas.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the chopped onion, diced potato, frozen peas, salt, and black pepper.
Roll out the filo pastry and cut it into small squares.
Place a tablespoon of the onion and potato mixture onto the center of each square.
Brush the edges of the pastry with a little water and fold the square into a triangle, pressing the edges to seal.
Repeat with the remaining pastry and filling.
Brush the tops of the samosas with a little vegetable oil.
Bake the samosas for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
While the samosas are baking, combine the yeast and 1/4 cup of warm water in a small bowl.
After the samosas have baked for 15 minutes, brush them with the yeast mixture.
Remove the samosas from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
